family.adjustment: Bonferroni: each two-sided percentile interval at 1 - alpha/8 (0.99375)
family.availability: A context contributes only if every fit it needs passed and every score it needs is defined. Block value = fsum mean of its available context values; estimate = fsum mean over the blocks with at least one available context. UNAVAILABLE if fewer than 20 of the 24 blocks have one.
family.endpoint_seed_rule: stable_seed(root_seed, endpoint_id): SHA-256 of the pipe-joined decimal/string parts, first 8 bytes big-endian, modulo 2**31-1 (E01 analysis convention).
family.law: Python random.Random(endpoint_seed); per replicate draw n block indices with replacement by n successive randrange(n) calls over the sorted order of the n available blocks; statistic = equal-weight fsum mean of the drawn block values; seeds and focals are retained inside blocks.
family.name: E06_primary_family
family.percentile: Linear interpolation at index (n-1)*p with p = (1-confidence)/2 and 1-(1-confidence)/2.

interpretation_limits: X1-X4: interval above zero = the ordering holds after one pass; containing zero = unresolved after one pass (not 'fails'); below zero = reversed after one pass.
Y1-Y4 are two-sided; a favourable gradient result is reported as such.
Unavailability is not a scientific null; unavailable endpoints stay in the denominator of 8.
Nothing here is evidence about larger models, other data sizes, or downstream audit utility.

population.weighting: equal available contexts within block, equal available blocks
